# qualys_web_applications (Data Source)

Look up Qualys WAS web applications, for referencing applications managed
outside Terraform in scan schedules.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "qualys_web_applications" "storefront" {
  name = "Storefront"
}

output "storefront_id" {
  value = one([for a in data.qualys_web_applications.storefront.web_applications : a.id])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- **id** (String) The ID of this resource.
- **name** (String) Return web applications whose name exactly matches this value.
- **name_contains** (String) Return web applications whose name contains this substring.

### Read-Only

- **web_applications** (List of Object) Matching web applications, ordered by ID for stable output. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--web_applications))

<a id="nestedatt--web_applications"></a>
### Nested Schema for `web_applications`

Read-Only:

- **created** (String)
- **id** (String)
- **name** (String)
- **url** (String)
